node.title: Re^3: Eval/package question
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I have a generic configuration in an Excel-file, and move it to several hashes by creating the commands as strings and eval-ing them.

As others have mentioned, stringy [doc://eval] is often not a good idea. Especially when working with hashes, what's wrong with the following?

our %items; my $item = '3'; my $key = 'Value'; my $value = 2; $items{$item}{$key} = $value;
